findings.issue: Early batch translates traer al banco as bring from the bank. Verify source/destination meaning in the final aligned sentences.

Early ayudar note says helping a person always uses an indirect-object le/les. Ayudar is transitive; teach lo/la as appropriate and label acceptable regional leísmo rather than asserting a universal indirect-object rule.
Explain ser for identity/classification and estar for state/location; do not teach permanence versus temporariness as an absolute grammar rule.

The Haiku report uses a fictional jurisdiction named Norland. Prefer a clearly named real language context (for example US tax vocabulary with fictional clients and figures), without inventing eligibility rules or implying a live tax calculation. The user wants realistic daily-work conversations. Fictional numerical illustrations are appropriate; invented country-specific terminology is not useful.
